resources.string: KCam is an independent fork of FadCam by FadSec Lab, licensed under GPL-3.0. Upstream credit and source: github.com/anonfaded/FadCam.

KCam is an ad-free, open-source recording app based on FadCam. No trackers, no ads, no analytics.

It is a GPL-3.0 fork: the original project is FadCam by FadSec Lab. KCam is not affiliated with or endorsed by FadSec Lab.
Cloud mode is not configured in this build. Local (Wi-Fi) remote still works.
This is a Pro feature in this edition.
